title: Flow Hive Bee Traffic vs Temperature
dataSources: Hive metrics (`flowhive:reading`), egg counter events (`eggcounter:event`), goat RFID visits (`goattag:scan`), goat watering and feed logs (`goatcare:event`), and compost readings (`compost:reading`).
app: Smallholding and backyard telemetry from Flow Hive scales, chicken coop counters, RFID goat tags, compost thermometers, and camera-driven chore logs sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flowhive:reading
| search bee_traffic_per_min=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(bee_traffic_per_min) as avg_bee_traffic_per_min avg(external_temp_c) as avg_external_temp_c by _time hive_id
| sort - _time
description: Tracks hive entrance traffic and temperature over time and breaks it out by hive.
value: Traffic alongside temperature helps separate normal weather effects from true colony weakness.
implementation: Send hive entrance traffic and temperature events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of hive entrance traffic and temperature by hive.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how hive entrance traffic and temperature changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
